snippet.title: Game With Balls - Announcement
snippet.description:
Working on a new small game: Game With Balls. A Steam Deck exclusive again where you move the Steam Deck to guide your balls through one of the handcrafted mazes. 

Wishlist Game With Balls: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3745250/Game_With_Balls

Get Better With A Friend: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2943100/Better_With_A_Friend/

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/geertjanverhoeff/

#steamdeck #indiegame
